name: TriMas
outlook:
What TriMas says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted earnings per shareThe Company has reaffirmed its adjusted diluted earnings per share (2) (EPS) outlook for full-year 2026 of $1.60 to $1.70.
  • Full year 2026: sales growthThe Company now expects 4% to 6% year-over-year sales growth across its combined Packaging and Specialty Products businesses, a modest increase from its prior outlook of 3% to 6%.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted operating profit marginThe Company also expects approximately 250 basis points of adjusted operating profit margin expansion year-over-year, reflecting the benefits of cost-reduction actions and organizational realignment initiatives, partially offset by the extended throughput challenges within Specialty Products.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
